svg.title: Figure 12 · Multiple testing under a zero-edge null
svg.desc: 400 independent experiments; each candidate has IID normal zero-mean returns, standard deviation 1%; training 504 sessions and independent evaluation 252 sessions. NumPy seed 5106. The toy trials are independent, unlike many correlated real strategy variants.
